worked_solution:
To find the $x$-intercepts of the hyperbola, we substitute $y=0$ into the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}}{36}-{y}^{2} & =1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{36}-{0}^{2} & =1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{36} & =1 \\ {x}^{2} & =36 \\ x & =\pm 6\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $x$-intercepts are  $(\pm 6,0).$
